mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.parent_project_id, pp.name AS parent_project_name, l.child_project_id, cp.name AS child_project_name, l.granted_by, COALESCE(gu.name, gu.username) AS granted_by_name, l.approved_by, COALESCE(au.name, au.username) AS approved_by_name, l.revoke_requested_by, COALESCE(ru.name, ru.username) AS revoke_requested_by_name, l.revoke_requested_at, l.status, l.created_at, l.approved_at FROM memory_project_links l JOIN projects pp ON pp.id = l.parent_project_id AND pp.deleted = 0 JOIN projects cp ON cp.id = l.child_project_id AND cp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users gu ON gu.id = l.granted_by LEFT JOIN users au ON au.id = l.approved_by LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = l.revoke_requested_by WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_project_members m WHERE m.project_id = l.parent_project_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('OWNER','ADMIN')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_project_members m WHERE m.project_id = l.child_project_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('OWNER','ADMIN')) ) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
